037
038        public static float PROB_COMPLICATIONS = 0.5f;
039        
040        public static float PROB_UNDERWORLD_BAR = 0.25f;
041        
042        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 365f * 3f;
043        public static int MISSION_CYCLES = (int) Math.round(MISSION_DAYS / 365f);
044        public static int CONTRACT_DAYS = (int) Math.round(365f * 5f);
045        public static int CONTRACT_MONTHS = (int) Math.round(CONTRACT_DAYS * 12f / 365f);
046        public static int CONTRACT_CYCLES = (int) Math.round(CONTRACT_DAYS * 1f / 365f);
047        
048        public static float REWARD_MULT_WHEN_PRODUCING_ALREADY = 0.2f;
049        public static float REWARD_MULT_WHEN_NOT_PRODUCING_ALREADY = 1f;
050        
051        public static enum Stage {
052                WAITING,
053                PAYING,
054                COMPLETED,
055                FAILED,
056        }
057        
058        public static enum Variation {
059                PRODUCING_ALREADY,
060                NOT_PRODUCING,
061        }
062        
063        public static class CheckPlayerProduction implements ConditionChecker {
064                protected String commodityId;
065                protected int quantity;
066                public CheckPlayerProduction(String commodityId, int quantity) {
067                        this.commodityId = commodityId;
068                        this.quantity = quantity;
069                }
070                public boolean conditionsMet() {
071                        return isPlayerProducing(commodityId, quantity);
072                }
073        }

079        protected Variation variation;

081        protected int needed;
082        protected int monthlyPayment;
083        protected int totalPayment;
084        
085        protected int monthsRemaining;

088        @Override
089        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
090                //genRandom = Misc.random;
091                if (barEvent) {
092                        setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
093                        String post = pickOne(Ranks.POST_TRADER, Ranks.POST_COMMODITIES_AGENT, Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER, 
094                                                                  Ranks.POST_MERCHANT, Ranks.POST_INVESTOR, Ranks.POST_EXECUTIVE,
095                                                                  Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE);
096                        setGiverPost(post);
097                        if (post.equals(Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE)) {
098                                setGiverImportance(pickHighImportance());
099                        } else {
100                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
101                        }
102                        if (rollProbability(PROB_UNDERWORLD_BAR)) {
103                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
104                                setGiverFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
105                        } else {
106                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
107                        }
108                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
109                }
110                
111                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
112                if (person == null) return false;
113                
114                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$cpm_ref")) {
115                        return false;
116                }
117                
118                if (barEvent) {
119                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
120                }
121                
122                PersonImportance importance = person.getImportance();
123                int minNeeded = 3;
124                int maxNeeded = 9;
125                switch (importance) {
126                case VERY_LOW:
127                        minNeeded = 2;
128                        maxNeeded = 4;
129                        break;
130                case LOW:
131                        minNeeded = 3;
132                        maxNeeded = 5;
133                        break;
134                case MEDIUM:
135                        minNeeded = 4;
136                        maxNeeded = 6;
137                        break;
138                case HIGH:
139                        minNeeded = 5;
140                        maxNeeded = 7;
141                        break;
142                case VERY_HIGH:
143                        minNeeded = 6;
144                        maxNeeded = 10;
145                        break;
146                }
147                
148                needed = minNeeded + genRandom.nextInt(maxNeeded - minNeeded + 1);
149                
150                MarketAPI market = getPerson().getMarket();
151                if (market == null) return false;
152                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) return false;
153                
154                WeightedRandomPicker<String> commoditiesPlayerIsNotProducing = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
155                WeightedRandomPicker<String> commoditiesPlayerIsProducing = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
156                
157                List<String> all = new ArrayList<String>();
158                for (CommoditySpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllCommoditySpecs()) {
159                        if (spec.isPersonnel()) continue;
160                        if (spec.isMeta()) continue;
161                        if (spec.isNonEcon()) continue;
162                        if (!spec.isPrimary()) continue;
163                        
164                        if (market.getCommodityData(spec.getId()).getMaxDemand() < minNeeded / 2) continue;
165                        
166                        boolean illegal = market.isIllegal(spec.getId());
167                        if (illegal && !person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD)) continue;
168                        if (!illegal && !person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE)) continue;
169                        
170                        all.add(spec.getId());
171                }
172                
173                for (String cid : all) {
174                        commoditiesPlayerIsNotProducing.add(cid);
175                        for (MarketAPI curr : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(true)) {
176                                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = curr.getCommodityData(cid);
177                                if (com.getMaxSupply() > 0) {
178                                        commoditiesPlayerIsProducing.add(cid, Math.max(1, 10 - com.getMaxSupply()));
179                                        commoditiesPlayerIsNotProducing.remove(cid);
180                                }
181                        }
182                }
183                
184                commodityId = commoditiesPlayerIsNotProducing.pick();
185                if (commodityId == null) {
186                        commodityId = commoditiesPlayerIsProducing.pick();
187                }
188                //commodityId = Commodities.VOLATILES;
189                if (commodityId == null) return false;
190                
191                if (commodityId.equals(Commodities.ORGANS)) {
192                        needed = Math.min(3, needed);
193                }
194                if (commodityId.equals(Commodities.DRUGS)) {
195                        needed = Math.min(6, needed);
196                }
197                
198                variation = commoditiesPlayerIsNotProducing.getItems().contains(commodityId) ? 
199                                                                Variation.NOT_PRODUCING : Variation.PRODUCING_ALREADY;
200                
201                
202                //float basePayment = getSpec().getExportValue();
203                float basePayment = 1000 + getSpec().getBasePrice() * 10;
204                if (variation == Variation.NOT_PRODUCING) {
205                        basePayment *= REWARD_MULT_WHEN_NOT_PRODUCING_ALREADY;
206                } else {
207                        basePayment *= REWARD_MULT_WHEN_PRODUCING_ALREADY;
208                }
209                
210                monthlyPayment = getRoundNumber(basePayment * needed);
211                totalPayment = (int) Math.round(monthlyPayment * CONTRACT_MONTHS);
212                if (monthlyPayment <= 0) return false;
213                
214                
215                setStartingStage(Stage.WAITING);
216                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
217                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
218                
219                connectWithCustomCondition(Stage.WAITING, Stage.PAYING, new CheckPlayerProduction(commodityId, needed));
220                setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null, Stage.PAYING);
221                
222                monthsRemaining = (int) CONTRACT_MONTHS;
223                
224                return true;
225        }

227        @Override
228        public void setCurrentStage(Object next, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
229                super.setCurrentStage(next, dialog, memoryMap);
230                
231                if (next == Stage.PAYING) {
232                        addPotentialContacts(dialog);
233                }
234        }

238        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
239                set("$cpm_barEvent", isBarEvent());
240                set("$cpm_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
241                set("$cpm_monthlyPayment", Misc.getWithDGS(monthlyPayment));
242                set("$cpm_underworld", getPerson().hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD));
243                set("$cpm_totalPayment", Misc.getWithDGS(totalPayment));
244                set("$cpm_missionCycles", MISSION_CYCLES);
245                set("$cpm_contractCycles", CONTRACT_CYCLES);
246                set("$cpm_commodityName", getSpec().getLowerCaseName());
247                set("$cpm_needed", needed);
248                set("$cpm_playerHasColony", !Misc.getPlayerMarkets(false).isEmpty());
249        }
250        
251        @Override
252        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
253                float opad = 10f;
254                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
255                if (currentStage == Stage.WAITING) {
256                        info.addPara("Produce at least %s units of " + getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " at " +
257                                        "a colony under your control.", opad, h, "" + needed);
258                        info.addPara("Once these terms are met, you will receive %s per month for the next " +
259                                        "%s cycles, for a total of %s, as long as production is maintained.", opad, h,
260                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(monthlyPayment),
261                                        "" + (int)CONTRACT_CYCLES,
262                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(totalPayment));
263                        if (!playerHasAColony()) {
264                                info.addPara("You will need to survey a suitable planet and establish a colony to complete " +
265                                                         "this mission.", opad);
266                        }
267                } else if (currentStage == Stage.PAYING) {
268                        info.addPara("You've met the initial terms of the contract to produce %s units of " + 
269                                                 getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " at " +
270                                                 "a colony under your control.", opad, h, "" + needed);
271                        info.addPara("As long these terms are met, you will receive %s per month over %s cycles for " +
272                                        "a total payout of %s, assuming there is no interruption in production.", opad, h,
273                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(monthlyPayment),
274                                        "" + (int)CONTRACT_CYCLES,
275                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(totalPayment));
276                        info.addPara("Months remaining: %s", opad, h, "" + monthsRemaining);
277                        if (isPlayerProducing(commodityId, needed)) {
278                                info.addPara("You are currently meeting the terms of the contract.", 
279                                                         Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(), opad);
280                        } else {
281                                info.addPara("You are not currently meeting the terms of the contract.", 
282                                                         Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), opad);
283                        }
284                } else if (currentStage == Stage.COMPLETED) {
285                        info.addPara("The contract is completed.", opad);
286                }
287        }
288
289        @Override
290        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
291                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
292                if (currentStage == Stage.WAITING) {
293                        info.addPara("Produce at least %s units of " + getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " at " +
294                                                 "a colony", pad, tc, h, "" + needed);
295                        return true;
296                } else if (currentStage == Stage.PAYING) {
297                        info.addPara("Receiving %s per month", pad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(monthlyPayment));
298                        info.addPara("Months remaining: %s", 0f, tc, h, "" + monthsRemaining);
299                        if (isPlayerProducing(commodityId, needed)) {
300                                info.addPara("Terms of contract met", tc, 0f);
301                        } else {
302                                info.addPara("Terms of contract not met", 
303                                                         Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 0f);
304                        }
305                        return true;
306                }
307                return false;
308        }

316        public static boolean playerHasAColony() {
317                return !Misc.getPlayerMarkets(true).isEmpty();
318        }
319        public static boolean isPlayerProducing(String commodityId, int quantity) {
320                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(true)) {
321                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(commodityId);
322                        if (com.getMaxSupply() >= quantity) return true;
323                }
324                return false;
325        }

327        protected transient CommoditySpecAPI spec;
328        protected CommoditySpecAPI getSpec() {
329                if (spec == null) {
330                        spec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(commodityId);
331                }
332                return spec;
333        }

338                super.notifyEnding();
339                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
340        }

342        @Override
343        public void acceptImpl(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
344                super.acceptImpl(dialog, memoryMap);
345                
346                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
347                uid = Misc.genUID();
348                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.PAYING, Stage.COMPLETED, getCompletionFlag());
349                
350                
351                if (rollProbability(PROB_COMPLICATIONS)) {
352                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(genRandom, getMissionId());
353                        //e.setDelay(0f);
354                        e.setDelay(MISSION_DAYS * 0.5f);
355                        e.setLocationInnerSector(true, Factions.PIRATES);
356                        //e.setEncounterInHyper();
357                        e.beginCreate();
358                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.VERY_LARGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, new Vector2f());
359                        e.triggerSetAdjustStrengthBasedOnQuality(true, getQuality());
360                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
361                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroInterceptFlags();
362                        e.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue("$cpm_commodityName", getSpec().getLowerCaseName());
363                        e.triggerSetFleetGenericHailPermanent("CPMPirateHail");
364                        e.endCreate();
365                }
366        }

368        public String getCompletionFlag() {
369                return "$" + getMissionId() + "_" + commodityId + "_" + uid + "_completed";
370        }

372        
373        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
374                if (currentStage != Stage.PAYING) return;
375                
376                int numIter = (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("economyIterPerMonth");
377                
378                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
379                FDNode colonyNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS);
380                FDNode paymentNode = report.getNode(colonyNode, getMissionId() + "_" + commodityId + "_" + uid);
381                paymentNode.income += monthlyPayment / numIter;
382                paymentNode.name = getBaseName();
383                //paymentNode.icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("income_report", "generic_income");
384                paymentNode.icon = getSpec().getIconName();
385                paymentNode.tooltipCreator = this;
386        }

388
389        public void reportEconomyMonthEnd() {
390                monthsRemaining--;
391                //monthsRemaining = 0;
392                if (monthsRemaining <= 0) {
393                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(getCompletionFlag(), true);
394                }
395        }
